name: brand-palette
description: Build an accessible brand color palette with light and dark mode values, checked against WCAG 2.2 AA and simulated for color blindness, published as a swatch board. Then turn it into a full brand reference page with brand-builder: story and motifs, color, charts, a signature move, typography, layout, live components, accessibility notes and CSS tokens. Pick and check its fonts with brand-typography: three free pairings measured against WCAG 2.2, APCA, the BDA dyslexia style guide and letter-shape legibility, on a specimen page.
